title: zeltnera exaltata
intro: Zeltnera exaltata, commonly known as tall blue-cup, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Zeltnera exaltata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
